subject: EdgeBank production inference: queue spike and elevated 5xx — urgent
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@edgebank.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeBank SRE Team <ops@edgebank.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production: elevated latency + 5xx across inference endpoints

Hi Nikhil,

We started seeing a broad increase in tail latency and a rise in 5xx errors on our production inference routes around 07:40 PDT. This is impacting several customer-facing flows (fraud scoring and risk models). Key observations: 
- P95 latency jumped from ~90ms -> 750ms.
- 5xx rate increased to ~6% across the /v1/generate endpoint.
- Errors correlate with queue depth in the dedicated GPU pool we have reserved.

I attached a CSV with sample metrics and a request payload for reference. Can you confirm if this is a customer-side change or a platform issue? We are seeing user-visible failures. This is high priority for us.

Attachments: [inference-metrics.csv] [sample-request.json]

—Tom
Tom Ellis
Director of Platform Engineering, EdgeBank
+1 415 555 0123
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@edgebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production: elevated latency + 5xx across inference endpoints

Tom — thanks for the data, and sorry for the impact. I'm triaging now. Quick plan: 
1) Stand up a short incident bridge (I can host) and loop in infra/ops.
2) Collect runtime traces and pool utilization from the Dedicated runtime.
3) If this is reserved-capacity related, propose immediate burst to avoid user impact and follow up on credits/contract amendment.

Can you grant temporary access to the EdgeBank SRE logs (ops@edgebank.com already CC'd) if there are any additional traces? I'll ping Marissa and the infra on-call for an immediate check.

I'll be on the bridge in 10.

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Production: elevated latency + 5xx across inference endpoints

Nikhil — initial findings from the runtime team after a quick look: 
- Dedicated GPU pool for EdgeBank hit sustained 100% GPU SM utilization on several nodes starting ~07:36 PDT.
- KV cache miss rate increased sharply for long-tail sessions; prefix cache not helping due to high variance in request sequences.
- Autoscaler didn't trigger additional nodes because reservation cap is configured at the committed level; overflow requests are queued and then retried -> 5xx amplification.

I've attached a short capacity dump and a stack trace of the request path. This looks like a reserved-capacity headroom issue, not a customer payload bug. Immediate mitigation options: 
- Authorize 48-hour burst (provision extra nodes in Dedicated pool) 
- Temporary routing to a compatible hosted model variant (lower-cost but higher headroom)
- Short-term token credits for EdgeBank while we sort provisioning and contract amendment

Attachments: [stack-trace.log] [capacity-report.pdf]

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Runtime Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Production: elevated latency + 5xx across inference endpoints — Exec attention requested

Team — forwarding EdgeBank incident. TL;DR: Dedicated reserved-capacity pool exhausted causing queueing -> 5xx and latency spike for a priority customer (deal D-8274). Customer is in production. Proposed immediate actions (need exec OK):
- Approve a 48-hour burst allocation to their pool (estimated cost impact: ~$7k/day).
- Offer a one-time service credit for the affected window if we confirm SLA breach.
- Fast-track an emergency amendment (procurement/legal) to increase committed capacity for the next quarter.

Why this is urgent: EdgeBank is a strategic FS account with volume growth; impact to their customers will lead to churn risk and executive escalation on their side.

If you approve, Marissa will kick provisioning and I will coordinate comms and credits. We need a decision within 30 minutes to avoid further user fallout.

—Nikhil

—David
